tools.name: Codex会话交接评估
tools.summary: Windows本地工作台，按需只读查看已有Codex会话状态。
tools.summaryEn: A local Windows desk for read-only snapshots of existing Codex sessions.
tools.directory: 实用小工具/Codex会话交接评估
requirements: Windows、已有PowerShell及Codex本地会话文件；其他系统未验收。
启动后运行仅本机服务并打开浏览器；数据保存在本包windows-local/.local下。
requirementsEn: Windows, existing PowerShell and local Codex session files; other systems are not validated.
Starting the desk runs a local-only service and opens a browser; state stays under windows-local/.local in this package.

tools.name: Codex任务续执行守卫
tools.summary: 按任务启用验收与有限续作，不接管已有桌面对话。
tools.summaryEn: Per-task verification and bounded continuation without taking over existing desktop chats.
tools.directory: 实用小工具/Codex任务续执行守卫
requirements: Windows、PowerShell、Node.js及已有可用认证的Codex CLI。
正式运行需明确授权的任务契约和经审查的只读验收器；不自动安装。
requirementsEn: Windows, PowerShell, Node.js and an existing authenticated Codex CLI.
A real run requires an authorized task contract and reviewed read-only checker; no automatic installation.

tools.name: Codex任务定位
tools.summary: 按明确项目路径及名称只读查本机会话候选，再由平台核身份。
tools.summaryEn: Find local session candidates by explicit project and name; verify identity through the host.
requirements: Node.js、Python 3及已获准访问的本地Codex元数据库。
查询只返回检查点候选，不能代替平台核验。
requirementsEn: Node.js, Python 3 and an authorized local Codex metadata database.
Lookup returns checkpoint candidates only; host verification is still required.

tools.name: Git仓库状态罗盘
tools.summary: 已迁至独立仓库，本目录仅保留入口。
tools.summaryEn: Maintained in its own repository; this directory is a pointer only.
tools.directory: 实用小工具/Git仓库状态罗盘

tools.name: Markdown阅读器
tools.summary: 离线阅读主动选择的Markdown文件，不修改原文件。
tools.summaryEn: Read selected Markdown files offline without modifying the originals.
requirements: 现代桌面浏览器；无需Node、安装或服务。
原文件自动记忆依赖浏览器接口与授权；不支持时使用普通文件选择。
requirementsEn: A modern desktop browser; no Node, installation or server is needed.
Remembering original files depends on browser APIs and permission; ordinary selection is the fallback.

tools.name: 知乎问答导出助手
tools.summary: 在浏览器中将知乎问题、回答及正常返回的评论保存为本机JSON。
tools.summaryEn: Export normally returned Zhihu questions, answers and comments to local JSON.
tools.directory: 实用小工具/知乎问答导出助手
requirements: 桌面Chrome或Edge；通过开发者模式手动加载扩展。
采集需要使用者自己已有的知乎访问权限及网络；不需要Node或Python。
requirementsEn: Desktop Chrome or Edge; load the unpacked extension in developer mode.
Collection uses your existing Zhihu access and network; Node and Python are not required.
